name: Fire Giant Lavamaster
tactics: Drawing forth the power of the fiery heart of the world, lavamasters shape the battlefield to their allies’ advantage. A lavamaster stays in the thick of the fray initially. However, once its allies begin to flag, it retreats and focuses on using magma burst to hinder enemies while its own forces are rejuvenated within its hearthflames aura.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Chainmail
items.description:
Metal rings woven together into a shirt, leggings, and a hood make up a suit of chainmail. Chainmail grants good protection, but it’s cumbersome, so it reduces your mobility and agility.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Chainmail grants +8 AC at levels 11-15, +9 AC at levels 16-20, +10 AC at levels 21-25, and +12 AC at levels 26-30.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Hearthflames
traits.details: Any enemy that enters the aura or ends its turn there takes 10 fire damage. Any bloodied ally of the lavamaster that starts its turn within the aura regains 10 hit points.

auras.name: Hearthflames
auras.details: Any enemy that enters the aura or ends its turn there takes 10 fire damage. Any bloodied ally of the lavamaster that starts its turn within the aura regains 10 hit points.

powers.name: Magma Lash
powers.usageDetails: when no creature is grabbed by the lavamaster

hit.description: fire damage, and the lavamaster pulls the target up to 4 squares. If the target ends the movement adjacent to the lavamaster, it is grabbed by the lavamaster (escape DC 23).

effect.description: The burst creates a zone of difficult terrain that lasts until the end of the lavamaster’s next turn. Any enemy that enters the zone or ends its turn there takes 10 fire damage. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

powers.name: Fiery Vendetta
powers.trigger: An enemy grabbed by the lavamaster attacks it.

effect.description: The lavamaster or one of its allies can make a melee basic attack against the triggering enemy as a free action.
